description: Delete a linked working directory and its registration.

categories.name: Options
categories.description: Selected documented options for this command path.

options.summary: Allow removal of a dirty linked worktree
options.detail: Removal deletes the working directory, including uncommitted files. Force is also required for a worktree with submodules. A locked worktree requires --force twice.
